summary: Quests for any game: quests by cycle with details, claim all and the quest points track.
description: A ready quests screen (Unity Runtime/UI/Quests) for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.quest. The title's quests: cycles as tabs (daily, weekly, achievements) with the timer to the next cycle, progress bars, a quest details popup with every goal, 'Claim all' for finished quests, and the quest points track with chests to claim along it. Registers the 'quests' feature; its badge counts finished quests. Ships title-seed.json: four daily quests.
provides: quest points track with milestone chests
